plugins.name: romhacking
plugins.description: ROM hacking method for game translation: a guided, gated workflow from unknown target to shipped patch. Skills covering text discovery, tables, control codes, DTE/MTE, pointers, compression, archives, disc images, expansion, graphics, fonts, VWF, accented glyphs, assembly hooks, glossary, QA and patching — each explaining the subject before the procedure. Orchestrates the emulator plugins instead of duplicating them.

plugins.name: psx-spx
plugins.description: Complete PSX hardware reference archived from psx-spx.consoledev.net. CPU, GPU, memory, DMA, CDROM, SPU, GTE, MDEC, controllers, BIOS, and more.

plugins.name: ghidra
plugins.description: GhidraMCP integration for Claude Code: MCP server configuration and reverse engineering reference. Decompile, analyze, and annotate binaries in Ghidra via MCP tools.

plugins.name: duckstation
plugins.description: DuckStation PS1 emulator MCP integration for Claude Code: runtime debugging, memory inspection, GPU/SPU state, breakpoints, VRAM watches, controller automation. 95 MCP tools.

plugins.name: armips
plugins.description: armips assembler reference for Claude Code: MIPS (R3000/R4000/Allegrex/RSP/EE) and ARM (ARM7/ARM9/THUMB) instruction sets, directives, expressions, macros, ROM hacking workflows, and project scaffolding.

plugins.name: mesence
plugins.description: MesenCE multi-system emulator MCP integration for Claude Code: runtime debugging, memory inspection, disassembly, tracing, ROM hacking, text search, and more. 57 MCP tools for NES, SNES, Game Boy, GBA, PC Engine, SMS, and WonderSwan reverse engineering.

plugins.name: ppsspp
plugins.description: PPSSPP PSP emulator MCP integration for Claude Code: CPU debugging, GPU/GE inspection, memory watchpoints, framebuffer dumps, texture/CLUT/depth/stencil inspection, vertex/matrix inspection, GE display list disassembly, GE breakpoints, HLE module listing, save states, game loading, controller input, and more. 47 MCP tools for PSP reverse engineering and testing.

plugins.name: exodus
plugins.description: Exodus Emulation Platform MCP integration for Claude Code: CPU debugging (M68000, Z80) with full registers, memory read/write/search, disassembly, breakpoints, memory watchpoints, VDP state/sprites/palette/nametables/VRAM/CRAM/VSRAM, and system control. 26 MCP tools for Mega Drive/Genesis reverse engineering.

plugins.name: psp-doc
plugins.description: PSP hardware and software reference, assembled from the archived YAPSPD chapters and the uofw/upspd documents: Allegrex CPU and how it differs from the PSX R3000A, memory map, caches, hardware registers, exceptions, Graphics Engine, file formats, modules, kernel and boot.
